description: Repairs r-ado-1b/persist-overwrite-flags: the flagged calls Save(path, 0, 1), (path, 0, 2) and (path, 1, 2) passed three arguments to Save(Destination, PersistFormat) and returned 0x8002000E (bad parameter count), so the overwrite question is unanswered. Only the one- and two-argument forms are used. On a client static read-only recordset of SELECT ID, Code, L, S FROM T ORDER BY ID (copy of r-ado-1b-main), each step with Connection.Errors read and cleared right after and the recordset State read: Save(o.dat) with the format omitted, reopened with adCmdFile (State, RecordCount); Save(o.dat) again to the same path; Save(o.dat, adPersistADTG) to the same path; Save(o.dat, adPersistXML) to the same path, reopened; Save(new-adtg.dat, adPersistADTG) to a new path, reopened; Save(new-xml.dat, adPersistXML) to a new path, reopened; Save(f99.dat, 99); Save with Destination omitted; Close then Save(closed.dat, adPersistADTG). The files are kept. Asks the default format, whether a second Save to an existing path is refused, and which forms are refused.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-wire-ado probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
